labelling: expected is the skill whose description most specifically claims the request: a phase skill when the query states the phase context, social when the binding or the phase must be established first, doctor when the machine or a connector is in doubt, none when no skill in skills/ applies today.
kind=target: the surface of the query and the expected skill agree. kind=near-miss: the surface points at another skill, or at a capability that does not exist yet.
split is fixed per item: tune descriptions against train, report on test, and never move an item between splits to make a number pass.

items.query: Ya estamos en la carpeta de Talleres del Norte y su store está vacío: ni BRAND.md ni nada. Arranquemos la fase 1: razón social, cómo escriben de verdad el nombre comercial, sector con su regulador y quién firma lo que se publica.
items.why: A bound company with an empty store and the phase-1 facts named is exactly the state social-identity's description claims.

items.query: This company has BRAND.md and DESIGN.md but no VOICE.md, and every draft we write for them reads like any competitor could have posted it. Derive their voice from what they already publish and fill in PROOF.md.
items.why: BRAND.md present, VOICE.md missing and copy coming out generic are the three cues social-voice names; the produce lure is a distraction.

items.query: La empresa ya tiene BRAND.md, VOICE.md y PROOF.md al día. Necesito el plan editorial de octubre: qué se dice, en qué red y en qué orden, listo para mandarlo a revisión del director.
items.why: All three documents exist and a new period needs deciding, which is social-plan's precondition and trigger; nothing is produced yet.

items.query: The director approved the October plan in the Doc yesterday. Write the copy and render the twelve pieces for Instagram and LinkedIn.
items.why: An approved plan whose pieces need making is the first trigger in social-produce's description.

items.query: La pieza 07 falló el render: el titular entra en la zona de la interfaz de Stories y el engine la rechazó. Arréglala y vuélvela a renderizar.
items.why: One piece failing a layout assertion is a composition defect that produce fixes; doctor's own description sends this case away from itself.

items.query: Las veinte piezas de octubre ya están aprobadas y renderizadas. Arma la entrega: calendario con horas, archivos y la nota de lo que falta hacer a mano. El cliente ya paga Metricool.
items.why: An approved, rendered batch that needs delivering plus a vendor already in use is handoff's trigger set.

items.query: The client says last month's delivery folder was missing half the images and the schedule CSV opened with broken accents in Excel. Redo it properly.
items.why: A previous handoff being incomplete is an explicit trigger in social-handoff's description; the corrupted CSV is its UTF-8 BOM concern.

items.query: ¿En qué fase del onboarding va Constructora Delta? Retomemos su trabajo de redes donde se quedó.
items.why: Asking which onboarding phase a company is in and resuming its work are named in the router's own description.

items.query: Restart Grupo Ferrer's onboarding from scratch. The BRAND.md we have was filled in by guessing and we can't trust a single field in it.
items.why: BRAND.md exists, which lures toward social-voice, but restarting a company's onboarding is identity's explicit trigger.

items.query: El cliente quiere publicar que 'reducimos 40% los costos de nuestros clientes'. Antes de que esa cifra entre en una pieza, regístrala con su fuente, quién la confirmó y cuándo se revalida.
items.why: A claim that needs a verification row before it can be published is social-voice's PROOF.md duty, even though the claim is bound for a piece.

items.query: Mañana es la primera sesión con Grupo Ferrer y trabajaremos desde su laptop. ¿Está listo el setup? Verifica que Drive lee, escribe y borra un archivo, y que regresan los comentarios de un Doc.
items.why: Before the first session with a new company and 'is the setup ready' are both named in doctor's description; the round trips are its checklist.

items.query: Mapea los procesos de la empresa: cuentas por pagar, compras y facturación con CFDI. Quién hace qué, cuánto tarda cada paso y dónde se atora.
items.why: The process router now exists and its description says outright to use it when asked to map or document processes. This item expected none while process-map and process-access were still roadmap items; leaving it would penalise the correct answer.

items.query: Build the monthly report from this company's journal: cycle time, touch time and throughput for the processes we touched.
items.why: The report skill now exists and reads the journal back. It supplies touch time; cycle time and throughput come from BASELINE.md, which its own description and STOP conditions say. This item expected none while report was a roadmap item.

items.query: Ya llevamos tres meses de bitácora con esta empresa. Revisa qué acciones se repiten y dime qué proceso conviene automatizar primero.
items.why: This query is verbatim the opportunities skill's case: several periods of journal, what repeats, what to automate first. It expected none while that capability was on the roadmap.

items.query: Write a LinkedIn post announcing Almacenes Ruiz's new warehouse. We haven't set up any brand or voice documents for this company yet.
items.why: Producing is impossible with no BRAND.md, so the router must establish binding and phase first; expected social, not social-produce.

items.query: Necesito una publicación de Instagram sobre la promoción del Buen Fin. No tengo idea de si esta empresa ya tiene plan aprobado ni en qué fase va.
items.why: The phase is unknown, so the router decides between plan and produce; jumping to social-produce would skip the approval gate.

items.query: The client left comments on the October plan Doc: fewer LinkedIn posts and nothing on Fridays. Revise it and send it back.
items.why: Revising after the client commented is a planning act named in social-plan's description; no piece is produced against an unapproved plan.

items.query: Para la semana que viene cambia el orden de lo que se publica y mete una pieza nueva sobre el evento del jueves; todavía no producimos nada de esa semana.
items.why: Reordering and adding a piece before anything is produced changes the plan, so it returns to the approval gate; 'lo que se publica' lures toward produce or handoff.

items.query: Add a case to test/render.test.mjs that proves the fill assertion fails on an empty canvas, then run npm test.
items.why: Plugin development: 'render', 'assertion' and 'fails' lure toward social-produce or doctor, but writing a test case is company-agnostic work no skill claims.

items.query: Their posts always say 'soluciones integrales' and 'líderes en el sector'. Turn what they actually publish into word rules a writer can follow, and get rid of the boilerplate.
items.why: Turning published material into word-level rules is voice extraction; rewriting their posts lures toward social-produce.

items.query: Quiero arrancar el onboarding de redes de un cliente nuevo, Ferretería La Central. Todavía no hay .company.json ni carpeta en Drive.
items.why: A new client's onboarding lures toward social-identity, but identity requires a bound company and is reached through the router, which binds first.

items.query: Las 32 imágenes de la corrida de hoy salieron en Segoe UI en vez de Archivo, todas, en cada formato. No es una pieza: es toda la corrida.
items.why: A substituted font on every asset is an install problem that doctor's description claims; the render failure lures toward social-produce.

items.query: Drive shows as connected in the settings, but the plan skill's read of BRAND.md failed twice with an authorization error.
items.why: A connector that shows as connected while a skill's call fails is doctor's case; 'the plan skill' lures toward social-plan.

items.query: Hazme la página web de una sola sección para la empresa a partir de su BRAND.md y su PROOF.md.
items.why: The web capability is on the roadmap; using the company's documents does not make a website social content, and no description lists the web as a platform.

items.query: Measure how long the team really takes to close an invoice today: three to five dated real cases, not an estimate.
items.why: The baseline skill now exists and its description covers measuring a before per process. The three-to-five-dated-cases phrasing is the elicitation rule that skill implements, not just doctrine.

items.query: Cerramos con Grupo Ferretero Sarmiento. Nunca hemos trabajado con ellos, no hay carpeta ni nada. ¿Cómo arranco para que quede bien desde el principio y no se me revuelva con los otros clientes?
items.why: No manifest and no folder exist yet. The binding has to be created before any document, and the stated worry about mixing clients up is exactly what the manifest prevents.

items.query: Ya tengo la carpeta de Sarmiento con su .company.json lleno, pero cuando intenté escribir el BRAND.md me dijo que no encontraba el store. ¿Qué está mal?
items.why: A manifest that exists but cannot reach the store is a health problem, not a binding problem. The surface says new company; the answer is the install check.

items.query: Mañana es la primera sesión con Sarmiento y no quiero quemarles dos horas preguntando cosas que ya tienen escritas. ¿Qué les pido de una vez para no andar goteando peticiones cada semana?
items.why: Requesting the documents a company already maintains, in one message rather than dripped, is intake's entire job.

items.query: Sarmiento ya me mandó su lista de precios y un par de cotizaciones reales. Necesito dejar asentado qué venden, con qué existencias y bajo qué condiciones de pago se cotiza.
items.why: The files already arrived, so this is no longer a request. Capturing what is sold and on what terms belongs to company-offer; intake only routes the file here.

items.query: En la junta salió que el gerente de ventas da descuentos hasta cierto punto y de ahí para arriba habla con el dueño, pero nadie me dio el número. ¿Dónde va eso y por qué me insistes tanto en ese dato?
items.why: The discount limit and who authorises past it is one of the five fields that decide whether a quoting automation is possible at all.

items.query: El dueño de Sarmiento dice que quiere automatizar cosas. No sé si ya deberíamos estar mapeando o si eso es otra fase. En el store ya hay BRAND.md y VOICE.md.
items.why: "Queremos automatizar cosas" fits both process phases, and the identity documents present say nothing about which. The router reads the store and decides.

items.query: Sesión de mañana con Sarmiento: hay que levantar todos los procesos que tienen, no sólo los que duelen. Son como veinte personas entre ventas, almacén y facturación y no tienen nada escrito.
items.why: Naming every process breadth-first, with nothing written down, is phase 3. The absence of written procedure is the finding, not an obstacle.

items.query: Ya está el PROCESSES.md de Sarmiento con las fichas, pero las secciones de dolor y accesos están en pendiente. El dueño quiere saber qué automatizamos primero y cuánto le costaría.
items.why: The inventory exists and the pain and access sections are pending, which is precisely phase 4's entry condition.

items.query: Sarmiento no tiene PROCESSES.md todavía y el dueño ya me está pidiendo el listado priorizado de qué automatizar con su costo.
items.why: The request names the phase 4 output, but with no inventory there is nothing to rank. The surface points at process-access; the correct answer refuses and maps first.

items.query: Antes de tocar nada en Sarmiento quiero dejar por escrito cómo están operando hoy: cuánto tardan en cotizar, cuánto retrabajo traen, cuántos procesos no tienen procedimiento. Para que en seis meses se pueda comparar.
items.why: A dated company-wide before, captured so a later comparison is possible, is the baseline capability and not a social measurement.

items.query: Ya pasó el primer trimestre con Sarmiento. Hay que volver a medir lo mismo que medimos al inicio y armar lo que se le entrega al dueño.
items.why: The re-measure is the quarterly report's own content. The surface says measure; the deliverable is the cadence report, which decides what may be claimed from it.

items.query: El dueño de Sarmiento me preguntó en la junta cuántas horas le hemos ahorrado y quiere el número para su consejo. ¿Qué le contesto?
items.why: Hours saved is a counterfactual. The report skill is where that gets refused and replaced with touch time and concurrency.

items.query: Sarmiento tiene Facebook, Instagram y creo que un LinkedIn que nadie usa. Antes de escribirles nada quiero saber cómo están hoy y qué tan mal está lo que ya publicaron.
items.why: Observing the current public state before producing anything is phase 0, and it has to happen before identity influences what there is to observe.

items.query: La agencia anterior de Sarmiento les dejó un reporte con su engagement rate comparado contra el promedio de la industria ferretera. El dueño quiere saber si vamos bien contra ese número.
items.why: Answering an agency's benchmark deck is explicitly presence work: it carries why no industry comparison is honest and what to score the deck against instead.

items.query: Hoy dejamos corriendo la cotización automática de Sarmiento en n8n. ¿Qué le tengo que entregar por escrito antes de irme, sobre todo si se equivoca un sábado y nadie está?
items.why: The day an automation goes live, what it does when it is wrong and who gets escalated to is the acceptance document.

items.query: La automatización de cotizaciones de Sarmiento lleva mes y medio corriendo. Toca decirle al dueño cómo le ha ido y si valió la pena.
items.why: How an automation performed over time is a cadence report. The surface says automation; handover is acceptance and happens once, on day one.

items.query: El dueño de Sarmiento me preguntó qué pasa si un día quiere apagar la automatización y yo no contesto el teléfono. Nunca lo habíamos escrito.
items.why: Whether the client can switch it off alone is the handover's own acceptance test, and its absence means the handover was never complete.

items.query: Sarmiento publicó en Facebook que son los distribuidores número uno del Bajío. Necesito un dictamen legal de si eso los expone con PROFECO y qué multa les tocaría.
items.why: Screening what is published is presence work, but a legal opinion with a fine estimate is not something this practice produces. The correct answer names a lawyer.

items.query: Ya tenemos el proceso de cotización mapeado y priorizado. Ahora constrúyeme el flujo en n8n con los nodos conectados y las credenciales puestas.
items.why: Building the automation is the automate capability, which does not exist yet. Only its handover doctrine and acceptance skill do, so the honest answer says so rather than routing to automate-handover.

items.query: Con todo lo que mapeamos de Sarmiento, ¿me armas la vacante y el perfil de puesto para que contraten a alguien que haga las cotizaciones?
items.why: Recruiting sits adjacent to the process map and the people document, but no skill claims job descriptions and inventing one would be scope creep.

items.query: Sarmiento me mandó el organigrama y la lista de nómina con puestos. Quiero que quede asentado quién decide de verdad y quién autoriza lo que se publica, porque el organigrama apunta a alguien que ya no está.
items.why: A document arrived and needs extracting, and the three facts confirmed with a person even when a file states them are intake's step 3.

items.query: El conector de Drive aparece en verde en la configuración pero cuando le pedí subir el PRESENCE.md de Sarmiento no pasó nada y no dio error.
items.why: A connector that shows as connected while a call silently fails is the exact case doctor exists for.

items.query: Siento que el plugin ya trae demasiadas instrucciones y se está haciendo lento. Quiero revisar si las skills y el CLAUDE.md están más largos de lo que deberían.
items.why: Rightsizing skills and CLAUDE.md is Claude Code's own built-in /doctor, not this plugin's install check. The disambiguation used to sit in doctor's description and now sits in its body, so this item tests whether the description alone still declines the request — the lure words are gone from it entirely, which should help rather than hurt.

items.query: We are three quarters into this engagement and the client is asking what to tackle next. Use what the journal already shows instead of putting them through another round of interviews.
items.why: Names the journal, several periods of history, and the next-phase question — the three things the opportunities description claims.

items.query: Ya tenemos tres meses de bitácora. Arma la lista corta de automatizaciones con puntaje y precio para presentarla al director el jueves.
items.why: The journal and three months of history lure toward opportunities, but scoring and pricing a shortlist in a session with the client is what process-access claims. Opportunities counts repetition; it does not score or price.

items.query: Read the journal back for the client review: how many actions, whose review time it took, and who approved what.
items.why: Reading the journal lures toward opportunities, but actions by actor, review time and named approvals are report's own list. Opportunities looks for what recurred across periods, not for what a period contained.

items.query: Apenas empezamos con esta empresa. Dime qué procesos conviene automatizar primero según lo que ya hicimos.
items.why: Automation priority lures toward opportunities and process-access, but a company with no journal history and no inventory is mapping work, and the process router is where that starts.

items.query: Este cliente ya trabajó con nosotros antes y tiene un par de documentos en su Drive, pero no hay ningún .company.json. Déjalo listo para retomar.
items.why: No manifest is the deciding fact and company-new owns the binding. Its description names the case of a store that already holds documents from earlier work, so pre-existing files must not route this away.

items.query: Ya hay BRAND.md y PROOF.md en la carpeta del cliente de un trabajo anterior. No los sobreescribas, incorpóralos y pídeme nada más lo que falte.
items.why: Adopting documents already in the store and requesting only the remainder is intake's step 0. The manifest already exists here, so company-new is not the answer.
